the birthday party that goes wrong for Cole

Cocktail frankfurts rolled in buttery puff pastry with a sesame top, baked golden and served hot with honey mustard and tomato relish for dipping. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap each strip around a cocktail frankfurt and sit seam side down on a lined tray. Brush with beaten egg and scatter with sesame seeds. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon mustard with 2 tbsp honey and serve alongside a bowl of tomato relish.
M: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner

Salmon roasted skin side down until just pink, with a shallot and white wine beurre blanc, crushed baby potatoes and bright green asparagus. Heat the oven to 220C. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes. Meanwhile simmer 1 finely diced shallot in 100ml white wine and 2 tbsp white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left, then whisk in 150g cold diced butter a piece at a time over low heat. Blanch 2 bunches of asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.
Lynn turns her back for a second and every cupboard is open

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with crisp streaky bacon, a pat of salted butter, fresh blueberries and plenty of warm maple syrup. Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Whisk in 500ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 50g melted butter until just combined and rest for 10 minutes. Fry 12 rashers of streaky bacon until crisp and keep warm. Brush a clean pan with butter and cook 80ml ladles of batter over medium heat for 2 minutes until bubbles show, then flip for 1 minute. Stack with the bacon, butter, blueberries and warm maple syrup.
W: the room goes cold when they're close
White chocolate melted into warm cream, cooled to room temperature, folded through whipped cream and a whisked egg white, set in glasses for 4 hours, a few raspberries on top.
K: Philly winter hot spiced apple cider

Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange, served steaming in mugs with a cinnamon stick and an optional nip of dark rum. Pour 1.5 litres cloudy apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 star anise, 1 sliced orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bring to a simmer, then keep it just below simmering for 20 minutes. Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each. Stir 30ml dark rum into the adults' mugs if you like.
